method: Manual browser observations of the loopback-served final build, plus separately recorded automated tests. This file records observations; it is not an automated browser test result.
limits: The final desktop home and reading-settings screenshots were visually inspected. Not every entry was manually viewed in the browser.
Mobile width and overflow were inspected; a successful manual horizontal table swipe is not claimed.
Local file navigation was restricted by the browser. Direct file-mode contracts are covered by tests and the same offline HTML bytes; this is not a manual file-protocol browser pass.
Age and sex filters, merged-entry aliases, bookmark migration and storage-failure behavior are covered by the 139-test run. Do not describe all of them as manual browser checks.
Browser and engineering checks do not constitute clinical review.
